extracted.name: How to cut cauliflower florets - efficiently, with least mess!
extracted.description: Don't you hate how tiny little bits fly everywhere when you cut cauliflower??? No more! Here's my quick and easy way to cut cauliflower.
instruction_lines: Cut whole cauliflower in half down the middle.
Cut the core out on the diagonal.
Use your hands to break into florets.
If you end up with some large ones, use a knife to cut into half or even thirds so all the florets are roughly the same size - this will ensure they cook through evenly. Use as directed by recipe!
